observations: body L7, L10-L11: the dashes of «al–Battānī», «al–Wānsharīshī» and «al–Ǵādirī» are long dashes (5.5 pt).
body L16-L17: Burgess' name is letter-spaced and divided between the lines; its hyphen is printed short, like a point.
body L20: the dash of «indo–arischen» is a long dash.

body (table): the table is boxed by double rules, the head separated from the rows by a single rule; the heads are in small capitals. The rule between the column of the names and that of the ages is drawn, over the first four rows, as a brace pointing to «ante V vel VI saeculum», which stands between the second and the third row; the rule runs on above and below the brace. The first row carries the signs of days, hours, minutes and seconds, the seconds' sign before the point; specks stand before «31.» in the second row and before «365» in the seventh.

body (table): the values that follow from the days of the yugas are right: 1577917828 days in 4320000 years (Sūrya-Siddhānta) give 365d 6h 12m 36s.56, 1577917500 days (Prior Ārya-Siddhānta) 365d 6h 12m 30s, and Brahmagupta's 1577916450000 days in 4320000000 years (Brahma Siddhānta) 365d 6h 12m 9s; the Romaka-Siddhānta's 365d 5h 55m 12s is Ptolemy's tropical year, 365 1/4 − 1/300 days.
body L31: the dash of the italic «Romaka–Siddhānta» is a long dash.
notes_left L1: the dash of «al-Battānī» measures 3.4 pt, the length of the hyphens of compound words in the notes; it is transcribed as a hyphen.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
